reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs support it: § 8(c) uses 'employees' only in an access-restriction covenant and § 8(d) references a separate Non-Competition Agreement solely as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data — neither imposes any solicitation, hiring or inducement restraint on Client.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline was rendered (redline text is identical to the originals) and no counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct treatment under the rule's preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer').
The two failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are expected artifacts where no covenant exists to measure, and do not indicate a defective edit.
The reviewer note flagging the out-of-document Non-Competition Agreement for separate diligence is appropriate and does not overstate the in-document position.
